# Qonto Tax Radar Skill for Muse

💳 Paid service required — needs a Qonto business account plus the Qonto MCP connector.
Curated by Skill Harbor — a free, open-source skill (MIT) by @qonto, listed here with credit to its creator. Rehearse a French tax audit on your real banking data — strictly read-only through the Qonto MCP connector (list_transactions, list_supplier_invoices, never any write). It screens your transactions against the eight axes real DGFIP auditors use: sumptuary spending, personal expenses booked as business, shareholder current accounts, VAT deducted without an attached invoice, benefits in kind, duplicates, cash, recurring round amounts. You get a risk report (🟢🟡🔴 per axis, amounts at stake, cited CGI articles, priority fixes) with honest "educational simulation, not tax advice" disclaimers and a loop you'll actually enjoy: fix, re-run, watch the score improve. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: French tax rules (it degrades to universal axes outside France); requires a paid Qonto business account plus the MCP connector; have an accountant validate before you act. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
